profile.name: Rohan Tandel
profile.title: Senior Backend Architect
profile.subtitle: AI-Augmented Distributed Systems & Event-Driven SaaS
profile.bio: Enterprise backend engineer with 8+ years of experience designing fault-tolerant, event-driven systems processing 2M+ daily requests across TaxTech, Telecommunications, and EdTech.
highlights: Accelerates delivery: Integrates AI pair-programming (Cursor/Copilot) to cut boilerplate coding by 35–40% and ship complex integrations faster.
Specializes in resilience: Architects idempotent event pipelines (SQS/DLQ), distributed locking, and cache strategies that achieve 99.95% uptime for enterprise SaaS.
Leads with impact: Mentors cross-functional teams, modernizes legacy monoliths, and translates business requirements into scalable, observable backend architecture.

experience.companyDesc: Enterprise TaxTech SaaS platform simplifying tax compliance across multiple countries.

roles.title: Sr. Integration & Backend Engineer
responsibilities: Leveraged AI-assisted development (Cursor/Copilot) to generate boilerplate API clients, retry-logic patterns, and TypeScript interfaces for 10+ country-specific tax authorities — cut integration lead time from 3 weeks to 10 days per module (65% reduction).

Designed and built robust backend microservices using PHP and TypeScript with fault-tolerant patterns: API design, advanced error handling, and exponential backoff retry logic for third-party tax authority integrations.

Developed and maintained Angular-based UI components that visualize complex integration workflows, allowing enterprise clients to configure connections, monitor data flow, and manage country-specific tax submission modules.
Implemented resilient async workflows using AWS Lambda, SQS, and EventBridge to decouple services — including DLQ setup and recovery mechanisms for failed transactions.
Instrumented services with structured logging and Datadog dashboards for integration health, throughput, and KPIs — reduced MTTD from 45 mins to 12 mins.
Performed API load testing with JMeter; implemented Redis caching and concurrency controls — reduced p95 latency from 1.2s to 320ms for high-volume tenants.
Applied tenant isolation, SSO, and RBAC across microservices ensuring full GDPR compliance — passed 3 external security audits with zero findings.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
responsibilities: Designed and implemented partner onboarding workflows with hierarchical account structures, supporting complex enterprise customer relationships for 200+ B2B clients.
Optimized Docker builds and modernized Bitbucket CI/CD pipelines — reduced deployment time from 25 mins to 8 mins and enabled zero-downtime rollbacks.
Led complete rewrite of the legacy transactions service into Golang while maintaining backwards compatibility through a robust versioning system.
Oversaw cross-team migration of vendor integrations from legacy PHP to FastAPI; established as key maintainer bridging functional and OOP paradigms for long-term code sustainability.

experience.companyDesc: Global IT services company delivering digital transformation projects.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
responsibilities: Project – Plusnet (British Telecommunications / Broadband Services): Migrated a legacy PHP customer-onboarding application to PHP (Laravel) + Angular, maintaining full API versioning.
Integrated backend modules with internal Java Spring Boot services to support critical customer-facing telecom workflows — ensured 99.9% data consistency across 10+ upstream services.

Led a multidisciplinary team of 4 engineers across India through planning, technical design reviews, and UX testing for internal customer portals — delivered all milestones on time for 3 consecutive quarters.

Project – Mindspark (Personalized Learning, 2M+ daily questions): Profiled API traffic and database query patterns with JMeter; identified and resolved Elasticsearch indexing bottlenecks improving system throughput.
Implemented server-side API input validator using JSON-based schemas, improving consistency and security for high-volume request processing.
Developed and integrated RESTful APIs to support core platform features ensuring seamless microservice communication and scalable feature delivery.

experience.companyDesc: Data synchronization platform for field operations with intermittent connectivity.

roles.title: Web Developer
responsibilities: Product – OfflineSync (Data Synchronization Platform): Owned full lifecycle (requirements → design → implementation → testing → rollout) of an offline synchronization solution for field locations with intermittent connectivity.
Led a team of 4 engineers through architecture discussions and troubleshooting complex implementation challenges for large-scale deployments.

items.title: API & Microservices Architecture

items.title: AWS Cloud & Serverless

items.title: Performance & Scalability Audits
items.desc: Identify bottlenecks, optimize queries, implement caching strategies and concurrency controls for high-throughput systems.

items.title: Third-Party Integrations
items.desc: Rapid integration with external APIs, tax authorities, payment gateways and telecom systems — with retry logic and error recovery.

items.title: AI-Augmented Development
items.desc: Leverage Cursor/Copilot tooling to accelerate delivery — boilerplate generation, LLM-assisted refactoring, automated test scaffolding.

items.title: Security & Compliance
items.desc: Implement RBAC, SSO, tenant isolation and GDPR-compliant architectures. Audit-ready systems with zero-finding track record.

items.title: Multi-Country Tax Integration Platform
items.problem: A European fintech needed to integrate with 10+ country-specific tax authorities, each with unique APIs, auth flows, and error contracts. Lead time was 3 weeks per country.
items.solution: Designed a decoupled integration framework using PHP + TypeScript microservices with a shared retry/backoff engine, AI-generated API client boilerplate, and an Angular dashboard for monitoring.
items.outcome: Cut integration lead time from 3 weeks → 10 days (65% reduction). Reduced p95 latency from 1.2s → 320ms. Passed 3 external security audits with zero findings.

items.title: Legacy Modernization — Plusnet Onboarding
items.problem: A British telecom's customer onboarding app was a brittle legacy PHP monolith tightly coupled to 10+ upstream services, causing frequent failures and slow deployments.
items.solution: Led full-stack migration to Laravel + Angular with API versioning, integrated with Java Spring Boot internal services and rebuilt CI/CD pipelines for zero-downtime deploys.
items.outcome: Achieved 99.9% data consistency across 10+ upstream services. Reduced deployment time from 25 mins → 8 mins. Delivered all milestones on time for 3 consecutive quarters.

items.title: Search & API Performance — Mindspark
items.problem: A personalized learning platform processing 2M+ daily questions was experiencing degraded search performance and API bottlenecks under peak load.
items.solution: Profiled API traffic with JMeter, identified Elasticsearch indexing inefficiencies, implemented JSON-schema API validators, and redesigned RESTful API layer for microservice communication.
items.outcome: Significant improvements in search throughput and system stability. Established consistent API validation patterns adopted across the platform.
